headline: &TEAM's 'Mark on Me' certified double platinum in Japan
sub: BOYNEXTDOOR's 'The Action' also goes platinum with RIAJ
caption:
&TEAM's Korean mini album 'Mark on Me' has been certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of Japan (RIAJ).

The certification means more than 500,000 copies were shipped in Japan. In the same monthly batch, BOYNEXTDOOR's Korean mini album 'The Action' was certified platinum for over 250,000 copies shipped.

📌 Source: RIAJ, Soompi, K-en News
